data.description:
Changes:

  • Added bot looting animations (opening containers, inventory opened)
  • Added config for max number of empty scan attempts before taking a short break
  • Fixed infinite looting loop caused by components not being destroyed when bot was extracted by SAIN. (Thanks @dwesterwick! #1, SAIN#42)
  • Fixed bots opening doors outside the looting layer
  • Fixed bots being able to loot items already in your inventory, or anyone elses
  • Fixed armor class calculation
  • Fixed interop ForceScan not actually forcing a scan
  • Fixed bots never disabling when at capacity (Maximum looting bots)
  • Fixed available grid spaces and total grid spaces
  • Fixed weapon stripping not checking all mods
  • Fixed useless magazines in the backpack not being thrown away
  • Exclude stripping magazines from weapons, the game does not like it and throws up
  • Swap out equipped armored rig if the corpse’s chest armor is better, or the same armor class and the corpse’s tac vest is larger
  • Allow multiple bots to loot the same container, only if the bot has no other friendlies looting the same
  • Bots can no longer pick up an item when it does not have enough space
  • Changing looting settings in-raid applies immediately instead of next raid
  • Enqueue priority corpse when looting was unsuccessful
  • Enqueue prioritized loot only if reachable
  • Calculate armor item price from its plates with config
  • Include in net worth calculation a container’s grid items value when swapping, picking up, equipping backpacks, rigs, etc.
  • Include ammo penetration power in deciding if weapon is better
  • Try to transfer item to corpse’s inventory instead of throwing on the ground
  • Do not throw dogtags when throwing undervalued items
  • Reworked weapon equip decider, this always equips the best weapon in the primary slot
  • Reworked stuck and distance checks
  • Reworked LootingBrain enabling so that it respects the Maximum looting bots config
  • Re-enabled AddExtraAmmo for bots when looting weapons, with Fika compatibility (Thanks Lacyway!)
  • Reverted activeloot persistence, this improves interop with Questing Bots
  • Refactored throw undervalued items, and throw unusable mag regardless of price
  • Workaround for successful network transaction but running indefinitely
  • Finish interacting with container before looting
  • Marked incompatible with Orbit, it has its own looting system
  • Updated dependency for DrakiaXYZ’s BigBrain to 1.5.0
  • Updated interop file
  • Distribute license
  • Inline exception handling
  • Reduced various allocations
  • Removed various redundant calls
  • Config defaults
  • Debug: Reuse debug spheres
  • Debug: Fixed initial net worth calculation
